ask: Post our season-finale recap on Mastodon, but behind a spoiler warning. And can you add a poll for the best moment?

arguments.content: Finale recap: the twist we argued about for weeks, and why the last scene works.

steps.why: The decision: a content warning, because Mastodon readers expect spoilers hidden; the warning is a short plain label. Unlisted keeps a recap off the public timelines while followers still see it. These are network-wide Mastodon settings, so they sit at network level. No poll: Mastodon polls are saved but never sent yet, so it isn't offered.
The settings were copied into Mastodon's own; read back sensitive, spoiler_text and visibility before saying they are set.

say: Saved to Acme as a Mastodon draft, unlisted, behind the warning "Spoilers: season finale": "Finale recap: the twist we argued about for weeks, and why the last scene works." A poll can't be added on Mastodon from here yet. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: visibility direct for a brand post: that's a private message.
Putting the Mastodon settings under accounts: only the network level is read.
